messages:
Maya (support): Hey team, customer reports streaming JSON mode sometimes cuts off mid-object. Happens ~5–20s into the stream. They see final brace missing and parser errors. Attached curl snippet from them below.

Alex (eng-runtime): Can you paste the original request shape? are they using structured_output/json mode + stream?

Maya (support): Yes:
```
POST /v1/generate?stream=true HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"model\": \"open-llm-13b\",
  \"mode\": \"structured\",
  \"prompt\": \"...\"
}
```
Customer curl (streaming):
```
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer ...\" \
  -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?stream=true
```
They say the response abruptly ends like this (literal tail):
```
data: {\"items\":[{...}, {\"id\":\"x\",\"value\":{...}}]\n\n```
(note: missing final closing `}` or `]` depending on run)

Ingrid (eng-infra): Interesting. Do they go through a proxy or CDN? That trailing `\n\n` looks like SSE frame boundary. Possibilities: upstream sent FIN, proxy dropped connection, or connection reset mid-chunk. Any intermediate hops?

Maya (support): Customer on GCP behind Cloudflare for their side but request goes direct to our API (no CF in front of Redwood). They use an internal proxy for outbound egress.

Jamal (eng-sre): Ping logs for that time range, looking for connection FIN/RESET on the ingress LB. Also check our keepalive timeouts vs. their proxy. If their proxy aggressively times out idle streams, can get mid-frame close.

Alex (eng-runtime): Hypothesis: our SSE chunker emits final object over multiple TCP segments; if the final segment is lost or we get a FIN from upstream between segments, client sees truncated JSON. We should detect if stream closed before sending sentinel end-of-object token and emit an explicit error frame like `data: __STREAM_ABORTED__` so parsers fail gracefully.

Maya (support): Customer asked for workaround — can we recommend disabling streaming? They prefer streaming. Any quick mitigations?

Ingrid (eng-infra): Short-term: increase keepalive probes on LB and reduce idle timeout mismatch. Also suggest they enable TCP keepalive and bump their proxy idle to >60s. Long-term: jamal/backoff, we add a final `data: {
